I searched the document separately for all 18 playbook rules and submitted one plan per rule. Summary of what the search surfaced:

**Located and routed for substantive review:**
- **LOL-CAP** — mutual consequential-damages waiver at §11.5 (p0572) with fraud/willful misconduct/gross negligence carve-outs; no monetary cap surfaced, flagged for worker confirmation rather than assumption.
- **INDEMN** — mutual indemnities (§11.1 p0559 ours; §11.2 p0560 Harpoon's) plus procedure §§11.3–11.4 and the patent-claim interface at p0471.
- **NONCOMPETE / EXCLUSIVITY** — §5.8 Competing Product covenant (p0367–p0369) with Acquisition/Segregate carve-out; licence-side exclusivity at p0353–p0356 and retained rights p0363. Noted the anti-double-flagging instruction.
- **T4C** — §12.3 Additional Termination Rights by AbbVie (p0590); Harpoon limited to breach/insolvency.
- **GOVLAW** — Delaware law §13.6 (p0652) plus the §13.7 dispute ladder including arbitration (p0655–p0657).
- **ASSIGN** — §13.4.1 consent standard (p0648), §13.2 Change in Control of Harpoon (p0643), CIC definition (p0086, p0092).
- **IP / LICENSE** — §7.1.1–7.1.4 ownership chain (p0427–p0433, p0445); grants §5.1–5.4 (p0351–p0360) and post-expiry irrevocable conversion (p0583).
- **AUDIT** — §6.11 audit of our records (p0419) and Audit Expert mechanic (p0420–p0421).
- **WARRANTY** — reps §10.1–10.2 and the all-caps disclaimer §10.5 (p0557).
- **INSURANCE** — §11.6 present and mutual, with our self-insurance right (p0573–p0579).
- **TRANSITION** — §§12.6–12.8 reversion/wind-down, survival, sell-off, and confidential-information return (p0596–p0640, p0518).

**Likely absent (flagged as such, not inferred from headings):** MFN (no hits across six phrasings), NOSOLICIT (only a mutual anti-inducement clause at p0424), RENEWAL (fixed royalty-term-driven term, no evergreen), LD (only default interest at p0418), MINCOMMIT (no take-or-pay; "minimum" hits are insurance limits).
